## Why visit

For a cider-focused visit, the AJ is more valuable than its plain appearance might suggest. The university’s own venue information explicitly welcomes the wider public and lists both cask ale and real cider, while CAMRA describes cider drawn from the cellar as well as handpumps. It brings a different kind of everyday Liverpool drinking culture into the trip, mixing university students, teaching staff and locals. Make the small uphill detour when cider matters; architectural grandeur is available elsewhere in abundance.

## Beer

Official university page confirms cask on handpull; CAMRA describes changing guest beers, normally including local ale.

## Cider and perry

**Real cider documented; reconfirm stock.** Both the university and CAMRA explicitly document real cider. Ask for the full cellar selection, not only visible handpumps.

See [how cider is classified](../real-cider.md).

## Food

The university advertises pizza; a practical bite rather than a destination meal.

## Plan the visit

Open to the public. University page lists Sunday closed; CAMRA notes term-dependent Saturdays and holiday changes. Cashless.

**Getting there:** University Square / Peach Street; a deliberate extension from the Hope Street pubs.
